resources.string: Show Android Auto on the BMW screen through Open Headunit on this phone. Install the receiver, enable Android Auto developer settings, and start its headunit server before starting here. Keep the phone unlocked in landscape with Open Headunit visible. Configure and test while parked.
Prompt for mirroring permission as needed:
Automatically times out if the car isn\'t connected within a minute
Next, open the app in the car
Please open the phone app to grant screen recording permission
Screen sharing could not start. Try again to grant fresh permission.
Install Open Headunit first, then try again.

Android asks permission each session. Share the entire display so Android Auto remains visible after it opens. Anything shown on the phone can appear in the car. Stop using the notification or this app. Locking the phone may end sharing.
